<thought>Using the mapped reaction for template 2895, the left‑hand side of the reaction (the reactants) is the precursor(s) for the product given. The left‑hand side SMILES (including atom‑mapping) is:
O=[N+:15]([O-])[c:14]1[cH:13][c:12]([N:11]2[CH2:10][CH2:9][N:8]([C:6]([O:5][C:2]([CH3:1])([CH3:3])[CH3:4])=[O:7])[CH2:27][CH2:26]2)[c:18]2[c:17]([cH:16]1)[CH2:25][CH2:24][C:20]1([O:19]2)[CH2:21][CH2:22][CH2:23]1
Thus the list of possible precursor combinations consists of this single set.
